description: Read HyperCore through HyperEVM L1Read precompiles (0x800-0x809). Positions, oracle/mark, spot, HLP vault equity, withdrawable. eth_call only. Never writes, never CoreWriter.

szDecimals.description: Asset size decimals from metadata, required to scale prices: 0..6 for markPx/oraclePx, 0..8 for spotPx. Omit only to receive raw price with unknown human units.
